MasjidSchedule.title: MasjidSchedule
MasjidSchedule.description: Shared Islamic prayer schedule with optional Azan overrides, Jamaat offsets/overrides, and community announcement.

ownerId.description: Firebase UID of the user who owns/manages this Masjid schedule.

masjidName.description: Display name of the mosque or community board.

shareCode.description: Short shareable code or ID for followers.

publicBoard.description: Whether any signed-in user can view and subscribe to this Masjid schedule.

useAutoLocationForEmpty.description: When true, empty Azan time fields fall back to device location astronomical calculation.

fajrAzan.description: HH:mm 24-hour Azan override for Fajr, or empty string for auto-location.

dhuhrAzan.description: HH:mm 24-hour Azan override for Dhuhr, or empty string for auto-location.

asrAzan.description: HH:mm 24-hour Azan override for Asr, or empty string for auto-location.

maghribAzan.description: HH:mm 24-hour Azan override for Maghrib, or empty string for auto-location.

ishaAzan.description: HH:mm 24-hour Azan override for Isha, or empty string for auto-location.

fajrJamaatOffsetMin.description: Minutes after Fajr Azan until Jamaat (default 15).

dhuhrJamaatOffsetMin.description: Minutes after Dhuhr Azan until Jamaat (default 15).

asrJamaatOffsetMin.description: Minutes after Asr Azan until Jamaat (default 15).

maghribJamaatOffsetMin.description: Minutes after Maghrib Azan until Jamaat (default 5).

ishaJamaatOffsetMin.description: Minutes after Isha Azan until Jamaat (default 15).

fajrJamaatOverride.description: Optional explicit HH:mm Jamaat time for Fajr.

dhuhrJamaatOverride.description: Optional explicit HH:mm Jamaat time for Dhuhr.

asrJamaatOverride.description: Optional explicit HH:mm Jamaat time for Asr.

maghribJamaatOverride.description: Optional explicit HH:mm Jamaat time for Maghrib.

ishaJamaatOverride.description: Optional explicit HH:mm Jamaat time for Isha.

announcement.description: Optional short community announcement (e.g. Jummah time).

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Per-user prayer calculation, subscribed Masjid board, and Azan alert settings.

subscribedMasjidId.description: Active Masjid document ID the user follows.

azanVoiceEnabled.description: Whether to speak Hayya alas-salah on Azan.

/masjids/{masjidId}.description: Shared Masjid schedules synced in real time to subscribers.

/users/{userId}.description: User-private preferences and saved location settings.
